roleContext.roleTitle: Site Services Supervisor, Integrated Facilities Management
roleContext.jobDescription: Our integrated facilities business delivers cleaning, porterage and front-of-house services to a business park of six low-rise office buildings under a five-year contract. The Site Services Supervisor plans the cleaning and porterage rotas within the contracted weekly hours, leads the frontline teams across the early and late shifts, keeps the chemical safety paperwork in order and presents the monthly KPI scorecard to the client's property manager. Because the supervisor is the nominated first aider on the late shift, a current first-aid at work certificate is required from the first day. The supervisor reports to the contract manager and covers the site helpdesk during the lunchtime peak.

requirements.text: Schedules cleaning and porterage rotas for a multi-tenant office site within the contracted weekly hours.
Leads frontline teams through shift changes and handles staff conflicts in line with the site's people procedures.
Runs the monthly client service review using the contract's KPI scorecard.
Maintains COSHH assessments and safe systems of work for cleaning chemicals and equipment.
Holds a current first-aid at work certificate.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Site Services Supervisor, Integrated Facilities Management

## Experience

- Site services supervisor at Harrowgate Facilities on a 22-storey multi-tenant office tower in Leeds, March 2021 to present; built the weekly cleaning and porterage rotas in the workforce scheduling tool against the contract's 310 weekly hours.
- Natural people leader with a calm, commanding presence; my team members say I am the best supervisor they have ever had.
- Prepared the monthly KPI scorecard (helpdesk response times, cleaning audit scores, tenant complaints) and presented it at the client service review with the tenant's property manager.
- Kept the COSHH assessment register for 22 cleaning products and rewrote the safe system of work for the ride-on floor scrubber after the supplier changed the model.
- Supervised 18 cleaning operatives and 4 porters split across the early and late shifts.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised client KPI scorecard for October 2023, showing response-time compliance, audit scores by floor and the complaint log with the action owner and close date for each complaint.
